description: Pipeline 1 robustness battery: surface noise (casing, punctuation, abbreviation, contraction), negation forms, compound/compoundless ingredients, and unrecognized cue phrases. Labels follow the rules in annotated_queries.json.

labeling_rules.available_ingredients: Canonical surface forms; ingredient mentions inside an exclusion clause never appear here.
labeling_rules.excluded_ingredients: One entry per excluded ingredient; 'no X or Y' yields two entries.
labeling_rules.calorie_max: Under, below, max, maximum, less than, up to, no more than.
labeling_rules.calorie_min: At least, minimum, over, greater than, between A and B.
labeling_rules.unset: null when the constraint is absent.
